messages.author: Hoang, Oanh Tu
messages.body:
Hello everyone,
I am running constant pH simulations with AMBER. My system is properly equilibrated and I did multiple production runs to validate the result, but I get a different conformation and H population every time. Does anyone know if this is normal or is there something i can change?
Best,
Tu

messages.author: Hoang, Oanh Tu
messages.body:
Hello,
I am doing constant pH MD with AMBER and in the pKa output  I get some inf and -inf values. If i want to calculate the average of the pKa or plot the results, should I leave the inf values out or do I have to set inf = 14 and -inf=-14 or 0?
Or would it be the best to take the average of the population and calculate the pKa with the Hendersen-Hasselbach equation?
Thank you in advance!
Best,
Tu

messages.author: Vinicius Wilian Cruzeiro
messages.body:
Hello Tu,
+ or - inf values indicate that your range of pH values is significantly off from your pKa. You should simulate more pH values in order to make pKa predictions for residues where this is happening.
I hope this helps.
